svg.title: FinAware — Data Model
svg.text: All 14 tables in the one SQLite database, with every column, its type and its keys, drawn from prisma/schema.prisma. Lines join a foreign key to the row it belongs to; the tag on each table names who writes it.
Not linked to a user: each rehab plan saves a snapshot of
its tips under the person's risk level.
Seeded demo data: 54 users with their debts, payment
histories and legal records; 12 of them also have a
Financial_Profile and a saved Money Plan (Budget_Item).
npm run seed rebuilds it all.
Every foreign key cascades: deleting a user deletes all of their
Looked up by value — no foreign key
Column marks: PK primary key (bold) · FK foreign key (blue) · UQ unique · Type? may be empty · the tag on each table names the service that writes it
FinAware · Data Model · drawn from the code · updated 29 September 2026
